# Library index

**Derived data. Do not edit.** Regenerate with `python3 tools/index_library.py`.

`library/` holds **0 filed works across 0 disciplines**, 0 carrying a source file and 0 carrying a note. `library/library-migration-temporary/` holds a further **0 files** as an unfiled, deliberately grep-able pool, summarised here by count and not enumerated.

A work with a note but no source file is a source read elsewhere and recorded here; a work with a source file but no note has not yet been cited, which is the just-in-time filing model in `library/CLAUDE.md` and not a backlog.

Paths are relative to the repository root. `src` marks a held source file, `note` a `notes.md` or a domain-level note.
